about_the_game:
You’ve been captured by the mysterious and definitely not friendly EGG CORP for failing to comply with their… let’s say, questionable rules. Now, your only chance is to break out of their crazy high tech facility before they catch you again.

This isn’t your average slow crawl through corridors. Nope, this is a fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by the chaotic and fantastic gameplay of KARLSON. Expect lots of running, jumping, dodging, and maybe some… well, messing around.

The levels offer plenty of moments to test your reflexes and timing, with surprises waiting around many corners. You’ll need to stay sharp and think fast if you want to escape in one piece.

The game is packed with:

  • Challenging platforming sections that keep things exciting (but not too hardcore)

  • Wacky environments and traps that keep you on your toes

  • A bit of humor and chaos, because why not?

Whether you’re a casual player or just someone looking for a wild ride, this game offers a unique blend of speed, skill, and fun. Ready to show EGG CORP that you don’t mess around?
